comment: Rows the source has wrong. clean_results.py applies these on every run. Each entry says why.

corrections.reason: The source stores this Kvalgrupp round 21 game as David Andersson (p1) against himself, 5-1, and lists only one David Andersson. The real opponent is unknown (David never meets Victor Enlund in the group, but Victor only played rounds 8-18), so the game is dropped rather than guessed.
